mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which lifts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing price index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer balance sheets, which reduces durable-goods demand and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST is below its 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and increases equity risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS is below its 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is below 5.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2% signals weakening macroeconomic momentum, which reduces earnings expectations and increases equity risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when 3-month average GDPC1 growth is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).
